newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential cuts two natgas cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential cuts two natgas cos.

text.p: Prudential Securities analyst Carol Coale confirmed she downgraded PanEnergy Corp and Consolidated Natural Gas Co to hold from buy.
-- Cited valuation issues for both downgrades.
-- PanEnergy's merger with Duke Power Co is expected to become final this month. Share price "is approaching the transaction value and any arbitrage opportunities are basically over," Coale said.
-- Said Consolidated price is approaching target. "We feel it's fully valued here.
-- PanEnergy closed at 47, Consolidated closed at 53-5/8.
